findings.title: Normalized review context is not bound to reviewed gallery
findings.measurement: 33 current Future records differ from hash-bound v12 gallery context; all 33 use v13 context. 27 current records match. All 60 reviewed task/candidate pairs still exist in their bound galleries.
findings.disposition: Canonical package untouched. Audit-only exact-context sidecar saved for all 60 current records; use the bound-gallery context in later jobs. Exporter repair deferred under Jobs 1–7 no-patch rule.

findings.title: One nonstandard JSON root pointer
findings.measurement: 526/527 pointers resolve literally. Pointer / targets an empty-key member under RFC6901; source has no such key. Exporter parse_carousel intends document root.
findings.disposition: Read whole hash-matched source with explicit interpretation; no silent canonical pointer edit.

findings.title: Historical review lacks gallery context
findings.measurement: future-volksgeist@2 task matching-derived-p01-1-05 / catalog-gap-clean has preserved comment but no context; current 60 records all have recoverable bound-gallery context.
findings.disposition: Do not interpret previous-beat reference without original review order/gallery. Scoped historical gap, not a current-review count gap.

findings.title: Manifest handoff path is mislocated
findings.measurement: architecture/storypackage/HANDOFF_data_matching_media.md absent at Story pin; actual architecture/HANDOFF_data_matching_media.md exists at same pin.
findings.disposition: Alternate read and hash recorded; original baseline manifest unchanged.

findings.title: Review retrieval and full feasibility are different executable paths
findings.measurement: Gallery calls template_candidates but not visualtask_requirements or _candidate_fit. General agent calls default fixture harness.
findings.disposition: Map separately; adequacy/causal impact reserved for later jobs.
